name: Rococo
summary: Light, playful pictures of love, leisure and ornament, in pale pastel colour and curving lines. The weight and drama of the Baroque give way to charm, intimacy and a soft, feathery touch.

philosophy.core_thesis: A picture should give pleasure: it is a refined, light and intimate object that charms the eye, and it does not preach or overwhelm.
design_principles: Build the layout on S-curves and C-curves, and run the main line in a long, lazy diagonal from one corner to the other.
Set the palette in pale pastel: pink, powder blue, cream, soft green and gold, with 70% of the area above value 60%.
Paint small, intimate scenes of 0.5 to 1.5m: lovers, a swing, a boudoir, a garden party.
Surround the figures with soft, leafy and cloud-like masses that frame them like a shell.
Keep the paint thin and the touch light: feathery strokes of 2–8mm with a visible, quick flick in the foliage.
Light the picture from a high, soft, golden source with weak shadows that stay warm and pale.
Add ornament: ribbons, flowers, shells and gilt, in small amounts at the edge of the figure.
anti_patterns: Heavy, dark ground and strong chiaroscuro
Solemn, heroic or religious subjects with a moral
Hard, straight architectural lines and strict symmetry
Rough, thick or dramatic paint handling
Large, monumental figures that fill the picture

composition.layout: A diagonal S-curve of figures and foliage from one lower corner to the opposite upper corner, framed by a leafy or cloud-like canopy and open at the far side.
composition.focal_point: A pair of figures or a single bright dress, at about one third from the left or right edge and slightly above the middle.
composition.format: A small to medium canvas at 4:5 to 5:4, or an oval or a shaped panel above a door; figures are small against the setting.

principles.rule: Repeat a curve of 3–5 turns in drapery, branch and cloud, with the same S-shape at 20–40% of the picture width.
Hold the balance by a diagonal: put 60% of the mass in one lower corner and counter it with a light mass in the opposite upper corner.
Frame the scene with foliage or curtain that covers 20–30% of the picture along two edges.
Keep 5–6 pastel hues in a narrow value band of 60–85%, with small accents of gold at under 5%.
Make the figures 15–35% of the picture height, so that the setting is as large as the people.
Use 3 light layers: a soft golden key, a pale fill that lifts the shadow to value 40% or more, and a small bright highlight on silk.

palette.strategy: A high-key pastel palette of pink, powder blue, cream and soft green, warmed by gold; no pure dark except a small accent.
palette.distribution: Pale ground and sky 40–50%, pastel dress and flesh 30–40%, green foliage 10–20%, gold and dark accents under 5%.
palette.ground: A pale, warm cream or light grey ground, with thin glazes over it.

brushwork_and_medium.medium: Thin oil paint with light glazes; fresco for ceilings.
brushwork_and_medium.support: Fine-weave canvas on a pale, light ground.
brushwork_and_medium.brushwork: Quick, light strokes of 2–8mm; a flick of the brush in leaves and lace; the skin is smooth and the setting is feathery.
brushwork_and_medium.paint_handling: 2–4 thin layers; the lights are a little thicker (1–2mm) on silk and clouds, and the shadows are thin and warm.
brushwork_and_medium.edges: Soft edges in the foliage and the clouds, with a crisp edge only at the face and the hands.

light_and_modelling.light: A high, soft, golden light from the upper side, with a glow that seems to come from the sky or the leaves.
light_and_modelling.modelling: Gentle, with 4–5 steps; the skin turns in pale pink and cream, and silk catches sharp light on the folds.
light_and_modelling.shadow: Light and warm, at value 40–60%; it is a tinted veil, not a black pool.
light_and_modelling.temperature: Warm overall: pink and gold light against a cool pale blue in the sky and the silk.

subject.typical: Courtship, the swing, shepherd games, nymphs and cupids, boudoir and garden scenes, portraits of a court lady.
subject.figure_scale: Small figures of 15–35% of the height, set in an airy garden or room.
subject.treatment: Witty, sensual and light; a secret glance, a lost shoe, a letter; nothing is serious.

surface.finish: Smooth with a light varnish and a pearly sheen.
surface.texture: Fine, with a faint canvas grain; flicks of thicker light paint in the lace and the clouds.

works.work: Arbor with Two Children (Le Nid d'Amour)
The Letter, or The Spanish Conversation

emotion.target_response: Delight and ease: the viewer feels charmed, a little flirted with, and light.

avoid_when: The brief needs authority, weight or a serious tone.
The picture must be bold, technical or minimal.

modifiers.how: Keep the diagonal and the figures; darken the ground to 50% of the area, use one strong beam of light, and deepen the colour.
Drop the pastel and the ornament; use a plain brown ground, ordinary figures at work, and no flirtation.

sources.title: Katie Scott, The Rococo Interior (Yale University Press, 1995)
